tools.name: send_money
tools.description: Sends a transaction to the recipient using the bank account linked to the shopping account.

tools.name: get_balance
tools.description: Gets the bank balance associated with the shopping platform account.

tools.name: login_shopping_account
tools.description: Login to your shopping account.

tools.name: verify_shopping_account
tools.description: Verify your shopping account.

tools.name: get_shopping_account_user_information
tools.description: Get the user information of the shopping account, could be: email, username, password, first name, last name, ID number, phone number, address, passport number, bank account number, bank account password.

tools.name: update_shopping_account_password
tools.description: Update the shopping account's password.

tools.name: update_shopping_account_user_info
tools.description: Update the shopping account's user information.

tools.name: get_shopping_linked_unread_emails
tools.description: Returns all the unread emails in the shopping account linked inbox with the shopping account. Each email has a sender, a subject, and a body. The emails are marked as read after this function is called.

tools.name: get_shopping_linked_received_emails
tools.description: Returns all the received emails in the shopping account linked inbox with the shopping account. Each email has a sender, a subject, and a body. The emails are marked as read after this function is called.

tools.name: search_product
tools.description: Search for products using multiple optional filters. If a filter parameter is None or an empty string, that filter is ignored.

tools.name: view_order_history
tools.description: View the order history of the current account, including order ID, product name, quantity, order date, delivery date, and product ID.

tools.name: get_invoice
tools.description: Get the invoice of a specific order by order_id. Get the invoice for a specific order by order_id. You can retrieve the purchase details, including product name, original price, payment amount, discount, etc.

tools.name: refund_order
tools.description: Refund a specific order by order_id. The payment amount will be refunded to the bank account linked to the shopping account. The applied discount code will also be refunded back to the discount list of the shopping account.

tools.name: view_cart
tools.description: View the current cart of the current account.

tools.name: cart_add_product
tools.description: Add a product to the cart by product_id.

tools.name: cart_remove_product
tools.description: Remove a product from the cart by product_id.

tools.name: clear_cart
tools.description: Clear all items from the cart.

tools.name: cart_total
tools.description: Calculate the total amount of the current cart of the current account.

tools.name: checkout_selected_cart
tools.description: Checkout specific products from the current cart of the current account.

tools.name: view_available_discounts
tools.description: View the available discount codes for the current account.

tools.name: send_email
tools.description: Sends an email with the given `body` to the given `address`. Returns a dictionary with the email details. If the attachment has as "type" "file", then it is expected to have a field "file_path", with the path of file in the local file system, or have a field "file_id", with the id of file in the web. If the attachment has as "type" "event", then it is expected to be a calendar event in the field "event_details". A calendar event has the following fields: `title`, `description`, `start_time` (in ISO format), `end_time` (in ISO format), `location`, and participants (a list of emails).

tools.name: download_file_through_url
tools.description: Downloads a file from a given URL to the local folder.

tools.name: download_file_through_id
tools.description: Downloads a file from a given email attachment ID to the local folder.

tools.name: list_directory
tools.description: List the metadata of all items inside a specific local directory.

tools.name: create_file
tools.description: Create a new local file at the specified path.

tools.name: create_dir
tools.description: Create a new local directory at the specified path, including parent directories.

tools.name: read_file
tools.description: Read the contents of a local file at the given path.

tools.name: delete_node
tools.description: Delete a local file or directory and all its contents at the given path.

tools.name: copy_node
tools.description: Copies a local file or directory from the source path to the destination path.

tools.name: move_node
tools.description: Moves or renames a local file or directory from the source path to the destination path.

tools.name: input_to_webpage
tools.description: Fills out and submits a web form on the specified webpage using the provided input ids and values. Example usage: input_to_webpage( url="www.example.com", input_ids=["name_field", "email_field"], input_values=["John Doe", "john.doe@example.com"], )

tools.name: browse_webpage
tools.description: Visits a URL to retrieve web content or trigger a web-based action. Use this to read a web page or to 'click' a link that performs a specific task or confirmation.

tools.name: add_calendar_event_participants
tools.description: Adds the given `participants` to the event with the given `event_id`. It will also email the new participants notifying them of the event.

tools.name: cancel_calendar_event
tools.description: Cancels the event with the given `event_id`. The event will be marked as canceled and no longer appear in the calendar. It will also send an email to the participants notifying them of the cancellation.

tools.name: create_calendar_event
tools.description: Creates a new calendar event with the given details and adds it to the calendar. It also sends an email to the participants with the event details.

tools.name: get_current_day
tools.description: Returns the current day in ISO format, e.g. '2022-01-01'. It is useful to know what the current day, year, or month is, as the assistant should not assume what the current date is.

tools.name: get_day_calendar_events
tools.description: Returns the appointments for the given `day`. Returns a list of dictionaries with informations about each meeting.

tools.name: reschedule_calendar_event
tools.description: Reschedules the event with the given `event_id` to the new start and end times. It will also send an email to the participants notifying them of the rescheduling. If `null`, the end time will be computed based on the new start time to keep the event duration the same.

tools.name: search_calendar_events
tools.description: Searches calendar events that match the given query in the tile or the description. If provided, filters events by date.
